scope: Native recheck only; prior CN/QCP/Fulminate evidence retained. No new model, Coq or kernel runs. No new benchmark input pairs.
memory_scope: GNU time largest single measured process peak RSS; not aggregate process-tree memory. Executor/spatial metrics are nested within CLI and must not be summed.
reproduction: Regenerate each row command binds file from its input plus case id; use a fresh temporary output directory. Original programs/spec/expectations were unchanged.

itp.unit: all residual VCs of one execution
itp.reason: Original DLL return VC remains in each inline execution; no metered proof attempt launched in this recheck.
